_meta.label: All three students are fictional, constructed for teaching purposes. No real likeness.
_meta.representation: Patterns (confident, quiet, discouraged) are not tied to any demographic trait. After the representation review, gender and skin tone were reassigned so neither maps onto the behavior patterns (quiet/dominant, discouraged/confident), and the hood was dropped as the withdrawal marker; see the decorrelation table in design/character-design.md. A human representation review has NOT been done and is recommended.
_meta.stateScale: u = understanding, e = engagement, c = confidence; integers 0-4

A.name: Jordan
A.pattern: Confident; answers fast; makes sign errors

B.name: Talia
B.pattern: Quiet; understands more than she shows

C.name: Sam
C.pattern: Discouraged by earlier failure; says 'I'm bad at math'

mixes.name: Run 1: the quiet student
mixes.description: Talia barely speaks unless given room. Jordan answers first. Sam is wary from the start.

error.misconception: M2 — sign error when moving a term
error.probe: Check the −5. What happens to it when it moves to the other side?
error.label: You flipped the sign wrong.
error.reviewNote: moving a term without changing its sign

mixes.name: Run 2: the dominant student
mixes.description: Jordan fills every silence and wants harder problems. Talia is a little more willing to talk. Sam makes the first error.

error.misconception: M3 — distributing to only the first term
error.probe: Look at the left side. What did the 2 multiply?
error.partialStep: The 2 multiplies both terms: 2 · x and 2 · (−4).
error.label: You forgot to distribute.
error.reviewNote: forgetting to distribute to both terms
